scripts.build:chrome: node scripts/write-manifest.mjs chrome store prepare && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist/chrome && node scripts/write-manifest.mjs chrome store
scripts.build:edge: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist/edge && node scripts/write-manifest.mjs edge
scripts.dev:chrome: node scripts/write-manifest.mjs chrome dev prepare && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist/chrome-dev && node scripts/write-manifest.mjs chrome dev
scripts.test: pnpm build:chrome && pnpm build:chrome:dev-bridge && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.build:chrome:dev-bridge: node scripts/write-manifest.mjs chrome dev-bridge prepare && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist/chrome-dev-bridge && node scripts/write-manifest.mjs chrome dev-bridge
